settings.title: Settings
settings.help: Select: Station, Passed days and Forecast days

temp.title: Temperature
temp.help: The gray band marks the current time

rh.title: Relative Humidity
rh.help: Relative humidity at 2 meters above ground (standar level)

ws.title: Wind Speed
ws.help: Wind speed at 10 meters above ground (standard level)

wd.title: Wind Direction
wd.help: Wind direction at 10 meters above ground (standar level)

wg.title: Wind Gusts
wg.help: Brief, sudden increases in wind speed that last for only a few seconds

press.title: Atmospheric Pressure
press.help: Typically pressure on mean sea level is used in meteorology. Surface pressure gets lower with increasing elevation

solarRad.title: Solar Radiation
solarRad.help: Shortwave solar radiation as average of the preceding hour, equal to the total global horizontal irradiation (GHI)

accRain.title: Accumulated Precipitation
accRain.help: Precipitation (rain + shower + snow). Daily accumulated (purple circles) and hourly accumulated (cyan bars)
